Detailed Description

template<class XFadeTextureEventType, class OwnerType = void>
class XFadeTexture< XFadeTextureEventType, OwnerType >

Crossfade events at timed intevals.

Creates a series of cross faded sounds from a user event class. The user event class should return a graph of unit generators that produce a continuous sound. XFadeTexture will apply an envelope to the sound to cross fade different invocations of the event.

This is different from Spawn which requires the envelope to be specified by the user.

See also:
XFadeTextureEventBase<OwnerType>, Spawn, OverlapTexture, TrigXFade
